en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an illustration of a street corner with multi‑storey townhouses. The main building is a traditional European inn or wine tavern with shuttered windows and awnings; pedestrians stand in front. On the right, a decorative scroll cartouche bears a greeting and the name of an establishment. The lower half of the card is filled with handwritten German text and a date.
